description: Department of Local Government - Eastern Province - Notice under Section 66(C) Summon the Meeting to the post of Chairman of the Manmunaipattu Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically deals with summoning a meeting to fill a vacancy for the Chairman position in a local authority under the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, including scheduling a meeting for election purposes, which falls squarely under Elections Gazettes (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
